reason_definitions.changed_jieba_segmentation: No token with the same start/end span exists in the other representation's Jieba token stream.
reason_definitions.chinese_character_normalization: Non-exclusive attribute: source and normalized substrings at the interaction span differ.
reason_definitions.filtering_differences: Non-exclusive category: at least one same-span or overlapping token in the other representation is ineligible under the unchanged 2–4 all-Chinese target policy. It is a consequence of the changed segmentation, not a changed filter rule.
reason_definitions.other: A same-span eligible token exists in the other representation but no interaction exists; this could include conversion failure or an unexpected pipeline discrepancy.
